prompts: Use case: stylized-concept game sprite atlas. The attached atlas is ONLY the exact visual STYLE reference: very thick slightly wobbly BLACK marker outlines, simple rounded geometry, flat limited pastel colors, tiny doodle details, NOT realistic or glossy. Generate a new TRANSPARENT 3 columns by 2 rows atlas with exactly SIX separate sprites in equal square cells, very wide transparent gutters, each object fully within central 75% of its cell. No labels, shadows, ground, text or grid. Row1 col1: ONE LONG SLENDER UPRIGHT GREEN CACTUS projectile, roughly four times taller than wide, rounded cucumber-like capsule with 2 simple dark green vertical ribs and small black spines along its edges. NO face, NO eyes, NO mouth, NO arms, NO feet, NO branches. It must look like a long cactus stalk thrown like a cucumber, not a round character. Row1 col2: powerful razor wind SHURIKEN, SIX broad angular silver/light blue sword blades radiating symmetrically from a small dark charcoal hub, each with an extra hooked cutting edge and one simple dark-blue bevel line. Dangerous bold pointed blade silhouette, much more substantial than a little flower, flat hand-drawn style, no face. Row1 col3: FIERY TORNADO animation pose A, upright wide-top narrow-bottom funnel made entirely from THREE or FOUR thick curved interlocking flame swirls, orange-red outer bands and pale yellow interior, black outlines, asymmetric flame tips along funnel sides. Recognizably tornado shaped. NO face, NO detached sparks, NO separate flames or smoke around it. Row2 col1: SAME fiery tornado pose B with the exact same overall height, width, center and band count, only its flame swirl curls shifted to show a turning motion. No additional detached effects, no limbs. Row2 col2: FACELESS BLAZING SUN projectile, round yellow-hot core with 2 or 3 irregular orange convection curves and a thick flowing orange-red corona of connected curling flames. Visibly seething and fiery, not simple triangle rays. NO eyes, NO mouth, NO nose, NO face of any sort, no detached particles, no realism, keep thick black doodle outlines. Row2 col3: BRACHIOSAURUS head facing RIGHT, unmistakably gentle long-neck herbivore with smooth light-green rounded head, broad blunt rounded muzzle, two nostril dots, one sleepy round eye and simple curved closed mouth, with a short tapering neck base extending LEFT. No teeth, fangs, horns, spikes, frill or mane. Just the head/upper neck of a brachiosaurus, not a full dinosaur body; the game animates a long neck separately. Must match the reference's sleepy doodle animal style. All SIX are transparent cutouts with clean complete outlines and plenty of empty alpha margins.

Edit ONLY transparency and unwanted outer glow in this six-sprite atlas. Remove ALL dark background pixels and ALL soft colored halos, glows, haze and shadows around every sprite. Outside the thick black outlines there must be perfectly transparent alpha immediately, completely empty transparent gutters. No bloom or surrounding flame effects. Keep ALL six actual sprite shapes, their thick black outlines, flat colored fills, layout, dimensions and positions unchanged. Keep the faceless long cactus, strong shuriken, two flame tornado poses, faceless sun and brachiosaurus. Close the open flat base edge of the brachiosaurus neck with a thick black outline so the entire cutout has a complete contour, without changing its shape. Preserve genuine transparency, do NOT draw a black/white/checkerboard background. Return the same 1536x1024 six-sprite atlas.

Precise single-cell edit. Image 1 is the six-sprite transparent atlas to edit. Image 2 is the existing game atlas as a style reference. In image 1, replace ONLY the bottom-right sprite (row2 col3), currently a gentle long-neck brachiosaurus, with a TYRANNOSAURUS HEAD facing right. Use the green dinosaur head from image 2 (second row fifth sprite) as the close design reference: chunky broad green skull and jaw, short rounded snout, sleepy round eye, small nostril, cheek dots and TWO visible cream triangular teeth. It must unmistakably be a short-neck T-REX head, NOT a long-neck herbivore. No long neck, no body, no limbs, no horns, no mane. Match the thick black doodle outlines and simple flat pastel green fill of the existing game. Keep the head fully inside the original bottom-right cell with transparent gutters. Keep all FIVE other sprites entirely unchanged: long faceless cactus, strong shuriken, the two fire tornado frames, faceless flaming sun. Preserve image1's exact 1536x1024 canvas, grid and real alpha transparency. No external glow, new effects, background, text or extra objects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE transparent game sword projectile, matching the supplied game's very thick BLACK marker outline and simple flat-color doodle style. Sword points horizontally RIGHT. A much more powerful-looking version of the tiny blue sword in the reference's top left: long broad deep PURPLE double-edged blade with a sharp angular spear point, two short backward-facing barbs near the blade base, a lighter lavender inner bevel panel and one bold purple central groove. Strong heavy silhouette, short dark purple handle at left, substantial dark charcoal crossguard with two violet angular tips and a small round violet pommel. Thick even black outline, few broad color shapes, readable at small size. NO face, eyes or mouth, no labels, no realism or metallic gradients. NO glow, smoke, halos, sparks or particles. Entire isolated sword with generous completely transparent alpha margin, no background or ground shadow. Only one sword.

Create a transparent RGBA game sprite atlas, 1536x1024, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows of 12 strictly separate cells. References define the same existing doodle idle game's art. Thick clean irregular black outlines, flat simple colors, minimal shading, round sleepy faces ONLY on creatures. No realistic rendering, no metallic gradients, no background halos/shadows, no frames, no text. Generous transparent margins around every cell. Never cross grid boundaries. Each of first ten cells is a compact square SKILL THUMBNAIL illustrating its attack, consistent in scale with reference 1 skill icons.
ROW 1 LEFT TO RIGHT:
0 Circular Blade: SIX strong purple swords like reference 4, pointed OUTWARD around a circle, black guards, violet blade facets. Clearly sword ring.
1 Summon Fire Golem: THREE rounded charcoal/orange golems in a compact triangular group, fists, two short feet each, tiny orange flame tufts, simple sleepy faces. No green thorns.
2 Cactus Rage: EXACTLY FOUR very long slim green cactuses in a diagonal fan, no faces, black thorn marks, black motion lines.
3 Fire Tornado: ONE big orange/yellow flaming spiral funnel, broad top, narrow bottom, no face, matches fire tornado in reference 3.
ROW 2:
4 Razor Wind Shuriken: THREE aggressive silver curved six-blade shurikens with charcoal hubs and curved wind lines. No faces.
5 Mighty Dragon: ONE red horned dragon, rounded sleepy face matching red dragon reference 2, sinuous beaded body, one clear matching pair of red bat wings swept back from shoulders, tiny orange breath puff.
6 God's Hand: ONE large peach open palm facing viewer fingers up, thumb left, EXACTLY FIVE fingers, two faint grey palm silhouettes slightly offset behind/below it to indicate falling afterimages. No fire.
7 Missile Rage: THREE red missiles with yellow noses and little orange exhausts aimed diagonally upper-right in a salvo, compact grouping, no faces.
ROW 3:
8 SAWBLADE SNAKES: EXACTLY FIVE short steampunk saw snakes in compact fan, each has a chunky brass-and-steel rounded snake head facing upper-right, sleepy slit eye, small forked tongue, rough jagged saw teeth along back of head and segmented coiled body. Brass gears, simple rivets, dark steel rims. Simple playful doodle style, not realistic or horror, no blood, no organic dinosaur teeth. Five visible heads, short bodies, not tangled.
9 Solar Volley: THREE FACELESS blazing orange/yellow suns with curling flame rims and black motion strokes, compact diagonal stagger. No eyes mouth or human features.
10 COMBAT SAW SNAKE HEAD ONLY: one large rounded brass/steel snake head aimed exactly RIGHT, sleepy slit eye, one small forked tongue, blunt compact snout, jagged steel sawblade ridges at back/top, brass gear circle and two rivets. Closed silhouette, NO neck/body/limbs, no dinosaur.
11 COMBAT BODY SEGMENT ONLY: one round pale brass gear bead with rough grey steel saw teeth around circumference, 3 simple rivets, black thick contour; no face no head no tail. Centered, single object.
References 2 and 3 are only design sources, do not reproduce their layout or unwanted dinosaur. Make all 12 cells separately crop-able on truly transparent background.

Make ONE surgical edit to this exact transparent 1536x1024 doodle skill sprite atlas. In TOP ROW THIRD CELL (the cactus volley thumbnail), there are currently FIVE cactuses. Remove ONLY the small lowest middle cactus centered near x916 y284, leaving EXACTLY FOUR cactuses (two upper tall ones and two lower/outer ones). Remove the deleted cactus completely to transparent background, leaving the other four intact. Preserve all other sprites, outlines, colors, alpha transparency, exact positions and dimensions pixel-for-pixel. Do not regenerate other icons. Keep the same 1536x1024 transparent RGBA image. No text, background, glow, or new objects.
